# cockroach_cluster_runtime_scanning (Resource)

Enable per-cluster runtime scanning (HBTD, host-based threat detection) enforcement. Creating this resource enables runtime scanning on the cluster; destroying it disables scanning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "cluster_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "cockroach_cluster_runtime_scanning" "example" {
  cluster_id = var.cluster_id
  type       = "WIZ"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.
- `type` (String) The runtime scanning (HBTD, host-based threat detection) provider to enable on the cluster.
  - Set to `WIZ` to enable the Wiz runtime scanning sensor.

Allowed values are:
  * WIZ

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Cluster ID. Matches `cluster_id`; present to uniquely identify the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# format: <cluster id>
terraform import cockroach_cluster_runtime_scanning.example 1f69fdd2-600a-4cfc-a9ba-16995df0d77d
```
